title: Emerson, Lake & Palmer - Karn Evil 9 (First Impression, Part 2)
description:
Karn Evil 9 is an intense, classically-rooted rock song by progressive rock supergroup Emerson, Lake & Palmer. It features organs, electric guitars, synth, bass, and drums. This song is crystalized madness that has been ground up, loaded into fireworks, and exploded for your amusement.

If you like the song, please check out the original. This 3 minute snippet hardly does it justice.


Come inside, the show's about to start, guaranteed to blow your head apart!
